item.title: Austin Convention Center Unveils First Look at Unconventional ATX
item.description: The Austin Convention Center Department (ACCD) has released the first renderings of the new Austin Convention Center, marking a major milestone in the City’s downtown transformation. Designed by LMN/Page, a joint venture, this cutting-edge facility will seamlessly integrate innovative architecture, sustainability, and public art to create a world-class event space in the heart of Austin.

item.title: Austin Visitor Center to Relocate to Historic Phillips Building
item.description: The Austin Visitor Center is excited to announce its relocation and grand opening in the beautifully restored historic Phillips Building at 103 E. 5th St.. The move, set for March 8, marks a new chapter for the center after 10 years at its current location. The Phillips Building, originally constructed in 1897, was once home to the Benson Motor Company, an early Austin Studebaker dealership, and is listed as a City of Austin Historic Landmark.

item.title: Visit Austin Promotes Dane Piper to Vice President of Destination Services
item.description: Visit Austin is proud to announce the promotion of Dane Piper to Vice President of Destination Services, marking a significant milestone in both his career and the organization's strategic evolution.

item.title: Visit Austin Recognizes Global Meetings Industry Day Amidst Exciting Convention Center Transformation
item.description: Visit Austin is proud to recognize Global Meetings Industry Day (GMID) on Thursday, April 3, 2025, a worldwide celebration highlighting the undeniable value of professional meetings and events to local economies and communities.

item.title: Visit Austin Appoints Tina Cannon as Vice President, Strategic Alliances & Executive Director of the Visit Austin Foundation
item.description: Visit Austin is pleased to announce the appointment of Tina Cannon as Vice President, Strategic Alliances and Executive Director of the Visit Austin Foundation, effective September 22, 2025.

item.title: Visit Austin Unveils Bold Digital Transformation, Launching New Website
item.description: Visit Austin, the official destination marketing organization for the City of Austin, announced the official launch of its completely redesigned website, www.visitaustin.org, debuting on Wednesday, November 5. The website is a representation of the city’s unique character, embracing Austin’s core identity and capturing the energy of its neighborhoods and creative ecosystem. The site is structured to highlight the rich tapestry of local businesses, artists and innovators who make Austin special.

item.title: Visit Austin Names Andrea Bean, CMP, Director of Sales
item.description: Visit Austin announced today the appointment of Andrea Bean, CMP, as its new Director of Sales, effective Monday, December 15. Bean brings over 20 years of sales and marketing experience, as well as a deep knowledge of the city's hotel landscape, to this leadership role within the Convention Sales department.

item.title: Visit Austin Names Arron Brooks Vice President Of Sales
item.description: Visit Austin announced today the appointment of Arron Brooks as its new Vice President of Sales, effective Monday, December 29. Brooks, who brings more than fifteen years of experience across hospitality sales, convention sales, and destination marketing, returns to Visit Austin to lead the Convention Sales Department.

item.title: Austin Film Commission Kicks Off 40th Anniversary Celebration with New Video Campaign
item.description: The Austin Film Commission is marking the 40th anniversary of the office with the release of a new video campaign that showcases Austin as a premier filming destination, while celebrating four decades of service the office has provided to the community.

item.title: Visit Austin Names Nathan Kopp Executive Director of the Austin Sports Commission
item.description: AUSTIN, TX – Visit Austin announced the appointment of Nathan Kopp as the new Executive Director of the Austin Sports Commission. Kopp, a dynamic sports industry executive with more than 15 years of experience driving sports strategy, large-scale events, and destination marketing initiatives, joins the organization to lead the strategic growth and operational excellence of Austin’s sports tourism efforts.
